purpose: Prospective operational criterion for considering a replacement primary model if the completed pilot cannot support the intended comparison.
timing: Declared during the primary pilot, before selecting or evaluating any replacement model. The primary model and active pilot remain unchanged.
trigger: Review the completed pilot by backend. If no arm produces an offline-valid translation on a backend, investigate backend/model viability before scaling. Infrastructure interruptions alone do not establish model incapability.

qualification.preflight: Both compiler fixtures and all three paid schema probes must pass, with the requested route and reasoning telemetry.
qualification.direct_baseline: At least one direct-arm offline-valid result on each of AMD and Intel for vector addition or transpose, within the existing case token, active-time and cycle budgets.
qualification.reason: These two kernels have passing original-source runtime evidence. A working direct baseline on both backends permits a meaningful comparison without choosing a model for a favorable IR-versus-direct difference.
qualification.retain_coverage: Run and report the complete unchanged three-kernel, two-target, three-arm pilot for each candidate. Layer normalization and every failed, unsupported or interrupted case remain visible; qualification does not remove them from reported coverage.
qualification.unknowns: Missing usage or timing cannot establish a budget-qualified success. An interrupted candidate is unresolved, not a model failure. Qualifying on development cases is not confirmatory evidence.

candidate_selection.ordering: Before paid candidate evaluation, archive a finite ordered list of open-weight model IDs, licenses, provider routes, reasoning settings and sampling settings. Do not add or reorder candidates in response to an observed IR advantage.
candidate_selection.selection: Use the first candidate in that archived order satisfying the qualification criterion. Do not rank candidates by the difference between arms or pool model-specific token/time comparisons.
candidate_selection.failure: If no candidate qualifies within available billing allowance, preserve the negative results and limit the research conclusion to observed backend/model failures. Do not claim a controlled efficiency advantage.

frozen_controls: three primary arms and their prompts
compiler identities and offline acceptance criteria
case token, active-time and cycle budgets
execution_gate: No replacement-model experiment before completion and review of the primary pilot. A new model requires a separate campaign; preserve all prior evidence and spending.
